say:2:1029715001:1.text: Ptooey—*cough* Ugh, the wind's worse here than anywhere else. How do they even stand it?
say:2:1029715001:1.source_cn: 呸，咳咳咳，这个地方的风比别处都强，他们居然能在这里放...

say:3:1029715002:1.text: They're persistent. That's how they've gone undetected this long.
say:3:1029715002:1.source_cn: 若非如此，我们也不会巡逻这么多次都忽视了他们。

say:4:1029715003:1.text: Look closer. This place is uncomfortable, sure, but it's close to the main road and near our settlement. Perfect for monitoring merchant activity and even our movements.
say:4:1029715003:1.source_cn: 唔，仔细看来，这里虽然不怎么舒服，但离大路不远，离氏族...

say:5:1029715004:1.text: I bet other regions that get attacked often have similar lookout spots.
say:5:1029715004:1.source_cn: 恐怕其他经常遭受盗匪袭扰的区域，也有类似的岗哨！

say:8:1029715005:0.text: To hide in weather like this and still stay alert... those bandits really are tough, in a way. *Cough*
say:8:1029715005:0.source_cn: 能在这样的风沙里潜伏监控，还随时隐蔽的盗匪，某种意义上...

say:9:1029715006:0.text: Oh, you're not looking too good. And even your duck seems exhausted. Are you both alright?
say:9:1029715006:0.source_cn: 啊，你看起来不太好，还有这只鸭子好像也没精打采的，没事吧？

choice_prompt:10:1029715006.text: Oh, you're not looking too good. And even your duck seems exhausted. Are you both alright?
choice_prompt:10:1029715006.source_cn: 啊，你看起来不太好，还有这只鸭子好像也没精打采的，没事吧？

say:11:1029715007:0.text: Yeah... no fur or scales means he's got no real protection from the sun or wind. Poor guy...
say:11:1029715007:0.source_cn: 啊，对！没有毛皮鳞甲，就是受不了风吹日晒，真是辛苦啊……

say:12:1029715009:1.text: This place really is rough. Come rest at our home, all of you!
say:12:1029715009:1.source_cn: 这里实在太艰苦了，各位，到我们那边去坐坐吧！

say:13:1029715010:1.text: It's the biggest oasis around. Go ahead and recover there!
say:13:1029715010:1.source_cn: 那可是这附近最大的一处绿洲水源，你们在那边好好休整下！

choice:10:0:1.text: He doesn't do well in sandstorms.
choice:10:0:1.male: He doesn't do well in sandstorms.
choice:10:0:1.female: He doesn't do well in sandstorms.

say:15:1029715008:0.text: With black feathers, he probably overheats faster too—even with his natural oils...
say:15:1029715008:0.source_cn: 毕竟羽毛是黑色的，在烈日下会更容易热吧，虽说羽毛上应该...
